blocks.text: There are many things _in_ my office. There is a brown desk _on the right_, _near_ the window. There is an orange desk _on the left_, _close to_ the door. There is a red, orange and yellow carpet _on_ the floor. There is a bookcase _between_ the window and the files. There are many books _on_ the _shelves_. There is a TV set and a stereo _in_ the bookcase. The files are _on the corner_, _near_ the bookcase. There is a computer _close to_ the door. There are many beautiful plants _around_ the office, and a big lamp _hanging from_ the ceiling. There is a picture _on_ the wall. The window is _in front of_ the door and _behind_ the brown desk.
Now answer the questions according to the example.

items: 1. Are there many things in my office?
2. Is there a brown desk on the right?
